とんかつ とんき 目黒本店.name: Tonkatsu Tonki Meguro Honten
とんかつ とんき 目黒本店.description: A renowned tonkatsu restaurant with a history of nearly 90 years. There is always a line during the day, but turnover is very fast. Their excellent operation is also a must-see: staff ask for your order when you come in, and what you ordered comes out piping hot as soon as you sit down.
とんかつ とんき 目黒本店.reservation: Dinner only, for groups of 4 or more

Nico Chelsea.description: A stylish French bistro tucked away in a back alley of Kagurazaka. It specializes in game meat (gibier). Which game is available depends on that day's supply, but every dish is excellent. You can pick your own wine from the wine cellar, which makes it fun. It is a very popular restaurant, so reservations are essential.

神楽坂 焼鳥 虎.name: Kagurazaka Yakitori Tora
神楽坂 焼鳥 虎.description: A yakitori restaurant on the slightly pricier side for Japan (though still only about $80). The yakitori itself is very good, and the all-you-can-drink plan even includes Yamazaki whisky, so it is great value. It has counter seats only, so going in a small group is recommended. Reservations are essential. Its Tabelog rating is low because it is a new restaurant with few reviews.

純米酒専門 粋酔 日本橋東京店.name: Suisui Nihonbashi Tokyo
純米酒専門 粋酔 日本橋東京店.description: A restaurant where you can drink as much as you like from more than 100 kinds of sake collected from all 47 prefectures of Japan. The range of sake is huge, and if you book a course, you can enjoy it all on an all-you-can-drink basis. The food is decent, so this is a place to go for the sake. Reservations for large groups are also possible.
純米酒専門 粋酔 日本橋東京店.note: It is unclear how well English is supported.

中国家庭料理大連.name: Dairen (Chinese Home Cooking)
中国家庭料理大連.description: A down-to-earth Chinese restaurant that has long been loved by students and office workers. The pan-fried gyoza are very good. It is definitely not the kind of place that appears in travel magazines, so it is recommended if you want to experience a restaurant where local Japanese people go.

フラクタル.name: Fractale
フラクタル.description: One of the top rum bars in Japan. It is so famous that when it comes to rum in Tokyo, almost every bartender will name this bar. Besides rum, it also has beer and whisky. An authentic bar with a calm atmosphere. Its Tabelog rating is low because it has few reviews; on Tabelog, bars generally tend to get low ratings.
